results.name: redisEnterpriseDatabase
results.reason: Learn version selector identifies 2026-09-01 as latest stable GA. Current and candidate create schemas support every supplied literal; required-field review, enum/type/literal checks, persistence constraint, and Bicep parent/name route semantics are complete.
results.migration: 2026-09-01 GA移行可能。全設定値の型・enum・literalが候補schemaと互換。

findings.detail: Current 2025-07-01; latest GA 2026-09-01. Exact current/candidate DatabaseCreateProperties models support the same used values. Candidate change log reports no changes in 2026-09-01; the 2026-02-01-preview notifyKeyspaceEvents addition is optional and unused.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: body:8: Bicep source JSON Pointer /name (expression "name: 'default'"); Bicep child name 'default' becomes the REST databaseName path parameter, not request-body JSON; it satisfies the path-name pattern.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: body:28: Bicep source JSON Pointer /parent (expression 'parent: redisEnterprise'); Bicep parent redisEnterprise selects the cluster route segment for the REST database endpoint; it is a path relationship, not a payload field.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: body:58: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties (expression 'properties: {'); Bicep properties object is the request-body envelope for DatabaseCreateProperties (which extends DatabaseProperties); it contains every value assessed individually below. No required create property is missing.

usage.label: clientProtocol
usage.analysis: body:80: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/clientProtocol (expression "clientProtocol: 'Encrypted'"); Maps to DatabaseCreateProperties.clientProtocol; exact literal 'Encrypted' is in the current and GA candidate string enum.

usage.label: port
usage.analysis: body:102: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/port (expression 'port: 10000'); Maps to DatabaseCreateProperties.port; literal 10000 is an integer and the schema imposes no conflicting bound.

usage.label: clusteringPolicy
usage.analysis: body:130: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/clusteringPolicy (expression "clusteringPolicy: 'OSSCluster'"); Maps to DatabaseCreateProperties.clusteringPolicy; exact literal 'OSSCluster' is an allowed enum value.

usage.label: evictionPolicy
usage.analysis: body:163: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/evictionPolicy (expression "evictionPolicy: 'NoEviction'"); Maps to DatabaseCreateProperties.evictionPolicy; exact literal 'NoEviction' is an allowed enum value.

usage.label: persistence
usage.analysis: body:193: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/persistence (expression 'persistence: { aofEnabled: false, rdbEnabled: false }'); Maps to the persistence object; the exact nested aofEnabled and rdbEnabled booleans are both false, satisfying the schema note that at most one persistence mode may be enabled. The allOf model has a duplicate accessKeysAuthentication override; that field was separately checked in both branches, and this persistence path is unambiguous.

usage.label: aofEnabled
usage.analysis: body:207: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/persistence/aofEnabled (expression 'persistence: { aofEnabled: false, rdbEnabled: false }'); Maps to Persistence.aofEnabled, boolean; false is type-correct and leaves AOF disabled.

usage.label: rdbEnabled
usage.analysis: body:226: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/persistence/rdbEnabled (expression 'persistence: { aofEnabled: false, rdbEnabled: false }'); Maps to Persistence.rdbEnabled, boolean; false is type-correct and leaves RDB disabled, so the mutually exclusive persistence modes are not both enabled.

usage.label: accessKeysAuthentication
usage.analysis: body:264: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/accessKeysAuthentication (expression "accessKeysAuthentication: 'Disabled'"); Maps to DatabaseCreateProperties.accessKeysAuthentication; direct create schema and inherited model both declare the string enum Disabled/Enabled, and the exact literal 'Disabled' is valid. Schemas expansion reports a duplicate inherited property, so the two source definitions were reviewed separately and the value validated against the direct property schema.

usage.label: deferUpgrade
usage.analysis: body:293: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/deferUpgrade (expression "deferUpgrade: 'NotDeferred'"); Maps to DatabaseCreateProperties.deferUpgrade; exact literal 'NotDeferred' is in the current and candidate enum.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: header:line:0: Bicep source JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 (expression "resource redisEnterpriseDatabase 'Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/databases@2025-07-01' ="); This is the resource declaration header, not a request property; it establishes the current API version being assessed and the resource is a create declaration, so the create request model applies.

current.analysis: Learn selector and exact stable spec identify 2025-07-01. The PUT body references Database; its create payload properties compose DatabaseCreateProperties with DatabaseProperties. Schemas helper checked clientProtocol, port, clusteringPolicy, evictionPolicy, persistence leaves, and deferUpgrade; the duplicate accessKeysAuthentication property in allOf was resolved by inspecting and validating both exact source definitions. All supplied values match.

ga.analysis: Learn selector lists 2026-09-01 as latest suffix-free GA and 2026-10-01-preview as newer preview. Exact 2026-09-01 REST request model retains each used enum/value/type; the only additional DatabaseProperties field relevant to the broader model is optional notifyKeyspaceEvents, which is not used.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log: 2025-07-01 changed the create model name from DatabaseProperties to DatabaseCreateProperties; the source request remains compatible with its exact current create schema. The 2026-09-01 GA entry reports no properties added, updated, or removed. notifyKeyspaceEvents was introduced in 2026-02-01-preview and is not set by this deployment. The duplicate accessKeysAuthentication allOf override was separately checked in both schemas.
